Digitpay ( Simple Payments. Seamless Finance ).

Digitpay Finance helps you pay, save, earn, and spend, all in one app.

Send money, pay bills, receive payments, and manage your finances effortlessly. Whether you're paying a merchant, sending money to a bank account, saving funds, or handling everyday transactions, Digitpay makes it simple and fast.

What You Can Do With Digitpay

• Send money to bank accounts
• Pay merchants and businesses instantly
• Pay bills and everyday expenses
• Save and manage your funds
• Receive payments easily
• Make investments (via supported partners)
• Manage multiple currencies in one app

Accept Digital Asset Payments (For Businesses)

Digitpay enables merchants to accept digital asset payments while receiving settlement directly in their local currency.

Customers can pay with stable-coins or supported assets, while businesses receive local currency without needing wallets, exchanges, or technical setup.

Built for Individuals & Businesses

Whether you're:
• An individual managing daily payments
• A freelancer receiving global payments
• A startup handling business transactions
• A merchant accepting modern payments

Digitpay gives you the tools to move money simply and securely.

Why Digitpay?

• Fast and reliable payments
• Seamless financial experience
• Built for African markets
• Secure and easy to use
• One app for your financial needs

Digitpay is building the future of finance simple, accessible, and designed for how money moves today.
